general_information.study_title: A Phase 2, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of Exampletinib Plus Carboplatin Versus Placebo Plus Carboplatin in Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
general_information.estimated_duration: Up to 24 weeks of treatment followed by a 30-day safety follow-up (about 28 weeks in total)

primary_objectives: To compare progression-free survival between exampletinib plus carboplatin and placebo plus carboplatin.

inclusion: Histologically confirmed stage IIIB-IV non-small cell lung cancer.
Total bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN; AST and ALT <= 2.5 x ULN.
exclusion: Prior treatment with a tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting the same pathway.

ae_definitions_and_classifications.ae_definition: An adverse event is any untoward medical occurrence in a participant administered a study intervention, whether or not considered related to the study intervention.
ae_definitions_and_classifications.sae_definition: A serious adverse event is any adverse event that results in death, is life-threatening, requires inpatient hospitalization or prolongation of existing hospitalization, or results in persistent disability.
ae_definitions_and_classifications.ae_relationship: Related or not related, as assessed by the investigator.

reporting_requirements.reporting_timeframes: SAEs must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours of awareness.
reporting_requirements.ae_data_collection_requirements: AEs are recorded from first dose until 30 days after the last dose.

safety_monitoring_and_management.safety_monitoring_plan: An independent data monitoring committee reviews unblinded safety data every 6 months.
safety_monitoring_and_management.discontinuation_criteria: Permanently discontinue study treatment for absolute neutrophil count < 500/uL lasting more than 7 days, platelet count < 25,000/uL, AST or ALT > 5 x ULN, or QTc > 500 ms.
safety_monitoring_and_management.emergency_procedures: Emergency unblinding through the interactive response system.

specific_ae_information.concomitant_medication_restrictions: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors are prohibited. Other investigational agents are not permitted.
specific_ae_information.special_population_considerations: Women of childbearing potential must use effective contraception.
